[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested three route options from Portland to North Cascades National Park:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Option 1: The Direct Route** - I-5 North towards Seattle, US-2 East towards Wenatchee, WA-20 East towards North Cascades National Park.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Option 2: The Scenic Route** - US-26 East towards Mount Hood, OR-35 North towards Hood River, I-84 East into Washington, US-2 East towards Wenatchee, WA-20 East towards North Cascades National Park.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Option 3: The Coastal Route** - US-30 West towards Astoria, US-101 North along the Oregon coast, US-12 East towards Yakima, US-97 North towards Wenatchee, WA-20 East towards North Cascades National Park.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] All routes will take the user to the park's western entrance, which is the most accessible point.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended checking the park's website for road closures or construction updates, filling up on gas and snacks, bringing layers for unpredictable weather, and downloading the park's visitor guide and map.
